burst: Charge Time is fixed. Effect varies according to the stage of Overcurrent. Only one effect is triggered at a time.
Stage 1 or below: Fixed at 3 sec.
Stage 5 or above: Fixed at 0.4 sec.

caveats: ⚑ skill1a/skill2c trigger is 'performing a Full Charge attack' — the engine has no fullCharge trigger kind; encoded as shotFired, which for this charge weapon (chargeFrames 60, ammo 6) is one trigger pull ≈ one full charge IF the player always full-charges. If the sim models partial-charge shots, shotFired OVER-fires both the HP stack ramp and the 7.15% gauge fill.

⚑ skill1a Max HP stack (1% of user's max HP ×30) is ally-granted Max HP — offensively inert per the e3 ally-grant rule except on self; kept for completeness and for any future HP-scaling consumer. rampSec 60 is an UNMEASURED estimate of the time to reach 30 stacks.

⚑ skill2b Overcurrent ATK ▲30% 'Up to 5 stages' is authored at per-stage value 30 with maxStacks 5 on a burstCast trigger — one stage per own-burst cast, so it ramps 30/60/90/120/150% across the fight. Whether a stage is gained per burst cast (the literal read) or by some other economy is kit-silent.

⚑ burst weaponSwap charge time is Overcurrent-stage dependent (3.0/2.5/2.0/1.5/0.4 s). The engine's weaponSwap has ONE chargeTimeSec; 2.0 s (stage 3) is a mid-fight estimate, not a measured value. Whichever single value is chosen mis-models the early and late fight in opposite directions.

⚑ burst weaponSwap durationSec 10 and shot economy are kit-silent (the kit states no swap duration). 10 s = the Full Burst window, an optimistic estimate; maxAmmo 1 means the swap reloads (141 base reloadFrames) between each shot, so the real shot count is likely 1-3.

⚑ 'Damage: 350% of final ATK / Full Charge Damage: 300%' is read as damagePct 350 with chargeMultPct 300 (the full-charge multiplier applied to the shot). An alternative read is 300% being an absolute replacement rather than a multiplier.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic is a Wind/SR/Supporter Burst II charge unit whose value is (a) a team gauge pump on every full charge, (b) an HP-scaled team ATK grant on her own burst, (c) a self ATK ramp (Overcurrent) that also shortens her burst weapon's charge time, and (d) a burst weapon swap with Pierce plus a 25%/10s team Attack Damage buff. The two load-bearing unknowns are the full-charge trigger fidelity (encoded as shotFired) and the Overcurrent-stage-dependent charge time, which the single-valued weaponSwap primitive cannot express.

flags.reasoning: The kit says 'when performing a Full Charge attack'. The TriggerDef union has no full-charge kind; shotFired is the closest (one trigger pull per charged shot on a charge weapon, chargeFrames 60). This is EXACT only if every shot is full-charged. If the sim fires partial charges, both the 30-stack HP ramp and the 7.15%/shot gauge pump OVER-fire — and the gauge pump is a rotation driver, so the error propagates to full-burst counts.
flags.recipe: Read her ammo counter + gauge bar frame-by-frame in a recording: count full-charge releases in the first magazine (6 rounds) and compare the gauge-bar delta to 6 × 7.15%. If the delta matches, shotFired is exact for her; if it is short, some shots are not full charges and a full-charge-only trigger primitive is needed.

flags.reasoning: 30 stacks at 1 stack per full charge. With ammo 6, chargeFrames 60 (1 s) and reloadFrames 141 (~2.35 s), one magazine ≈ 6 s + reload ≈ 8.4 s for 6 stacks ⇒ 30 stacks ≈ 42 s of uninterrupted fire, longer with burst downtime. 60 s is a conservative round estimate; the value is UNMEASURED and the stack cap is never reached instantly.
flags.recipe: Time from battle start to the 30th full charge in a recording (count charge releases). Set rampSec to that elapsed time. Note the grant is ally-scoped Max HP, which is offensively inert under the e3 rule, so this ramp moves no damage unless a HP→ATK consumer is on the team.

flags.reasoning: The kit line is 'ATK ▲ 1% of the skill user's final max HP' — an ATK grant scaled by the CASTER's Max HP, granted to ALL ALLIES. The schema's atkOfMaxHpPct is documented as scaling the unit's OWN final Max HP (self-conversion), and casterAtkPct scales the caster's ATK, not the caster's HP. Neither primitive expresses 'x% of the caster's Max HP added as flat ATK to every ally'. The chosen encoding is therefore MAGNITUDE-WRONG in a way I cannot fix blind: it will add 1% of caster ATK rather than 1% of caster Max HP. Since Supporter static ATK ≈ 98,367 while Max HP is a much larger pool, this under-credits substantially. Flagging rather than inventing a number.
flags.recipe: Confirm the correct primitive with the engine owner: either extend atkOfMaxHpPct to accept a caster-scoped ally grant, or add a casterMaxHpAsAtkPct StatKey. Then measure: run a fight with and without her burst and read a teammate's popup values; the flat ATK delta should equal 0.01 × her final Max HP.

flags.estimate: one stage per own burstCast, maxStacks 5, 30% each
flags.reasoning: The kit says 'Activates when using Burst Skill … ATK ▲30% continuously. Up to 5 stages in total.' The literal read is one stage per own burst cast, permanent. Over a 180 s fight a Burst II unit casting on most rotations plausibly reaches stage 5, but the exact accrual rule (per cast vs per some other condition) is kit-silent, and the burst charge-time ladder implies the stage is expected to climb across the fight.
flags.recipe: Read her burst charge time in a recording across successive bursts: the ladder (3.0/2.5/2.0/1.5/0.4 s) directly reveals the current Overcurrent stage. If charge time drops one rung per burst, one-stage-per-cast is confirmed and the ATK ramp follows the same schedule.

flags.reasoning: The kit gives a 5-rung ladder tied to Overcurrent stage; weaponSwap exposes a single chargeTimeSec. Picking 2.0 s (stage 3) approximates the mid-fight state but over-charges early bursts (real 3.0 s) and massively under-charges late ones (real 0.4 s at stage 5, a 5× difference in shots per swap window). This is the single largest modeling error in the override.
flags.recipe: Either measure the real per-burst charge times from footage and, if stage 5 dominates the damage-relevant bursts, retune chargeTimeSec to 0.4; or request a stage-gated weaponSwap (a resourceGate on an Overcurrent resource pool with one swap block per rung) so the ladder can be expressed faithfully.

flags.reasoning: The kit states NO swap duration. 10 s is the Full Burst window and the standard optimistic default. With maxAmmo 1 the swap weapon reloads between every shot: at base reloadFrames 141 (~2.35 s) plus the charge time, a 10 s window yields roughly 2-3 shots at stage 3 and more at stage 5. The kit is silent on whether the swap weapon inherits the base reload speed.
flags.recipe: Count Matis UberBuster shots and time the swap window in a recording of her burst. Set durationSec to the observed window and add maxShots if the swap ends on a shot count rather than a timer.
